sla_status: analytical threshold; not an official customer promise
applicability_limitation: Restaurant food-delivery data is used as a proxy for quick-commerce operations. Clusters are demand-zone candidates, not confirmed optimal store locations. Do not generalize without validation on actual quick-commerce data.
rider_experience_limitation: Rider professional experience/tenure is not present; age is not used as a substitute.
